text:
deploy-bot: initiating phased rollout v2.4.2 -> sequence [US then EU then APAC]. window_per_region=25m. initial slices: US=20% -> EU=10% -> APAC=5%. auto-rollback=false (manual gate enabled for APAC bump).
lina: heads-up: EU GPU pool reported a recent surge 20m ago. need a quick health/gap check before ramping to 30%.
sre-oncall: pulling metrics now. EU pool: 6 active nodes (V100 equiv), free slots 2, 5m avg util 78%. memory margin low for sustained 30% on short notice. recommend warm +3 nodes if we plan 30% within next 10m.
mike: can we spin warm nodes in parallel with US ramp? US can go full slice first.
sre-oncall: yes, warming +3 nodes in background. ETA ~6m. warming job id: infra-warm-281003. tracking in ops board.
katie: US canary looks clean: p95 latency -2ms vs baseline, error rate steady. token cost flat. heatmap shows no regression. :white_check_mark:
release-manager: plan: proceed US -> monitor 15m -> if green, ramp EU to 30% after warm nodes finished -> APAC stays at 5% for 30m then manual approval for 25% bump. Pin config set: `model.pin=2.4.2-stable`.
ajay: explicit rollback criteria please (we need thresholds on dashboard and runbook).
devops: adding watch alerts now. proposed triggers: error_rate >= 1% sustained 5m OR p95_latency increase >= 250ms over baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR OOMs > 0 in 3m. also watch token output ratio > 2.5x anomaly.
lina: confirm SLA headroom for EU if warm nodes added?
sre-oncall: with +3 nodes EU headroom improves to ~22% for bursts; sustained margin ok for 30% but recommend throttled traffic shaping from 30->60% to avoid sudden spikes.
mike: deploy-bot, please set gradual ramp policy for EU: 30% for 10m, then 60% for 10m, then 100% if stable.
deploy-bot: EU ramp policy updated: [30% 10m] -> [60% 10m] -> [100%]. manual gate before 60%.
katie: APAC note: quota for GPUs in that region is 60% of EU per-availability; even with bump we may need regional fallback to small-quantized model if we hit CPU throttling. I'll prep fallback route: `model/quantized-v2` pinned as region-fallback.
release-manager: approved. adding explicit rollback runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollbacks-v2. doc lists step-by-step rollback, who to page, and how to pin back to 2.4.1: `kubectl annotate deploy model-serving pinned=2.4.1 --overwrite`.
ajay: also want a quick checklist for on-call: where to post, who to loop in.
lina: checklist: 1) slack #eng-oncall + #eng-releases update, 2) create incident if error_rate > threshold, 3) exec rollback command, 4) confirm post-rollback smoke tests.
sre-oncall: warm nodes online in EU now. healthchecks passing: 200 OK, no OOMs last 15m, KV cache prefill success.
mike: US rolled to 100% -> good. EU moving to 30% now per policy.
deploy-bot: EU slice moved to 30% (timestamp 2799998921).
sre-oncall: EU metrics nominal at 30%. p95 +40ms, error_rate 0.12%. continuing monitoring.
katie: starting APAC limited rollout at 5%. will keep a strict watch on queue latency and GPU steal.
release-manager: reminder: change window ends in 25m per region. if anything looks off, use rollback triggers and file incident. logging final notes to ticket: RD-4721.
ajay: thanks team. I'll keep the dashboard feed open and give a 15m status update. :eyes:
devops: added adhoc Grafana panel: `rollout:v2.4.2` with the key thresholds.
lina: minor FYI — we should run a short cost check after EU 60% step; last time we saw token-cost jump w/ a config shift.
sre-oncall: noted. will snapshot cost metrics at each step.
release-manager: closing loop: US -> success. EU -> progressing to 60% after manual thumbs (waiting on mike). APAC -> held to 5% for now. will reconvene in 12m.
